Our technology platform provides for integrated discovery, design, and development of RNA-based products and gives rise to three distinct capabilities that underpin a sustainable business model and bring capabilities normally used in advanced pharma discovery to agriculture and human health: • Identification and design : Machine learning and proprietary algorithms are key tools as we work to identify the best gene target candidates for dsRNA-based products and seek to design safe and effective dsRNA against those targets.
